posts.text: From my AI: Here's the OpenClaw competitor landscape from across your 16 lists: Direct Clones / Forks: MaxClaw (MiniMax) — always-on managed agent based on OpenClaw, powered by MiniMax M2.5 (first major Chinese fork). Kimi Claw (Moonshot). PravalClaw (Python-based). Spiritual successors: Majordomo (pre-built agent library), Moonshift (post-coding execution), opencode (coding-specific fork), Agent One (security-first, built in 3 days with Opus 4.6 + n8n). YC-backed: emdash ADE (Agent Development Environment, run multiple coding agents in parallel). Coding agent competitors: @tylbar unnamed agent (no compaction needed), @dungle_scrubs open-source agent, Letta Code (memory-first, Apache 2.0). Pattern: everyone builds (a) hosted managed OpenClaw, (b) Chinese model fork, or (c) coding-agent variant. The 'ADE' framing is the next evolution: OpenClaw as the IDE, not just CLI.
